title: Writing Limits and Deductibles on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**Clause 1 — building limit.** On a General Property Form tier of the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) the building limit may not exceed the tier's fixed maximum building coverage. On an RCBAP tier the building limit may not exceed the lower of the tier's building limit per unit times the number of units on the policy and the building replacement cost value.

**Clause 2 — contents limit.** The contents limit may not exceed the tier's maximum contents coverage, and contents coverage insures only the property described by the tier's contents owner basis.

**Clause 3 — increments.** Limits are written in whole multiples of the tier's coverage increment.

**Clause 4 — deductibles.** Each deductible must be one of the tier's listed options and may not exceed the tier's highest deductible. The minimum building deductible is the lower minimum when the building limit is at or below the deductible threshold and the higher minimum when it is above.

**Clause 5 — minimum contents deductible.** The minimum contents deductible is the tier's minimum contents deductible. *This clause is no longer in force for the contents deductible a contents proof of loss subtracts; for every other minimum contents deductible it remains in force as written.*

**Clause 6 — no election.** An application or endorsement that elects no deductible takes the tier's defaults, raised to the applicable minimum.

**Clause 7 — out-of-bounds values.** A limit or deductible outside these bounds is written at the nearest permitted value only when the customer accepts that value, and otherwise it is not processed.

**Clause 8 — coinsurance notice.** On an RCBAP the association is told at application and at each renewal the coinsurance requirement that its building limit must meet to avoid a penalty at loss.

The tier figures each clause reads — fixed maximum building coverage, building limit per unit and maximum contents coverage — are those of the product's limits schedule for the tier written.

## Building cap by form (hypothetical figures)

| Form | Inputs | Building cap |
|---|---|---|
| General Property Form | any number of units | the fixed maximum building coverage |
| RCBAP | 4 units, replacement cost value 1,200,000 | lower of 4 times the per-unit amount and 1,200,000 |
| RCBAP | 2 units, replacement cost value 350,000 | lower of 2 times the per-unit amount and 350,000 |

## Points of judgement

- A requested limit or deductible outside the bounds is written at the nearest permitted value only if the customer accepts that value; without acceptance the request is not processed.
- An application electing no deductible receives the default; if the default were below the applicable minimum it would be raised to that minimum.

superseded_clauses: the minimum contents deductible is min_contents_deductible.
